## 3. Product Portfolio

### Alumni AI (Beta & Next Gen)
- **Production URL**: https://alumni-ai-teamalum.vercel.app/
- **Description**: An AI system with multiple operational modes, Artifact Studio for live interactive code & HTML rendering, Chrome-powered web browsing for verified real-time research, and structured student aids.
- **Hosting**: Vercel Serverless (FastAPI / Python + Static frontend).

### Team Alum Official Platform
- **Production URL**: https://team-alum.vercel.app/
- **Description**: The official digital home of Team Alum showcasing products, leadership, vision, and a direct inquiry channel powered by Supabase.

### Atlera Timer
- **Production URL**: https://atlera-timer.vercel.app/
- **Description**: A focused Pomodoro and stopwatch application engineered for distraction-free study, featuring ambient soundscapes, aesthetic themes, and zero-distraction UX.

### Nexora Platform
- **Production URL**: https://app-c0l89hyi92pt.appmedo.com
- **Description**: Academic suite and student utility platform.

### Prompt Engineering Blueprint
- **Production URL**: https://teamalum-bookstore.vercel.app/
- **Description**: In-depth publication and educational bookstore covering prompt design patterns and LLM interactions.
